name: mil188qammod
expr: y = mil188qammod(x, 16); z = mil188qamdemod(y, 16); rt = isequal(x, z); zn = mil188qamdemod(y + 0.05*(1+1i), 16); rtN = isequal(x, zn);
comment: MATLAB mil188qammod / mil188qamdemod (MIL-STD-188-110 QAM). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on M=16. KNOWN GAP: only M=16 currently shipped; M=32, 64, 256 require additional MIL-STD constellation tables (each well-defined per the spec, deferred to its own cycle). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship mil188qam in core; reports N/A.
